plugins.name: seamless
plugins.description: Seamless sessions: /clear at any time and the next session carries on. A living handoff document, a skill that restores it, and a SessionStart hook that hands the fresh session the previous one's context.

plugins.name: fleet
plugins.description: A fleet of executor subagents, one per model and reasoning effort, governed by a single rules file: which model may spawn which model at which effort, which skills and commands a subagent may not use. The main session keeps full power; the rules bind only the fleet. A task handed to a fleet agent must arrive as a structured brief.

plugins.name: kiro-sidecar
plugins.description: Delegates work to Kiro CLI agent sessions over the Agent Client Protocol, in a Docker container or locally. Each call returns at once, and when a Kiro turn ends its result is pushed back into the conversation by a hook, so Claude can answer Kiro and keep one session going across many turns.
